definition.en: Animal husbandry is a critical branch of agriculture dedicated to the breeding, rearing, and management of livestock to support the Indian economy and rural livelihoods.
definition.hi: Animal husbandry is a critical branch of agriculture dedicated to the breeding, rearing, and management of livestock to support the Indian economy and rural livelihoods.

importanceInUpsc.en: For UPSC GS-3, this topic is vital for understanding agricultural diversification, rural income growth, food security, and government interventions like the Rashtriya Gokul Mission. Questions frequently test the economic impact of livestock on small and marginal farmers.
importanceInUpsc.hi: For UPSC GS-3, this topic is vital for understanding agricultural diversification, rural income growth, food security, and government interventions like the Rashtriya Gokul Mission. Questions frequently test the economic impact of livestock on small and marginal farmers.

learningOutcomes.en: Understand the economic contribution of livestock to the primary sector and GDP.
learningOutcomes.hi: Understand the economic contribution of livestock to the primary sector and GDP.

learningOutcomes.en: Analyze government schemes and institutional frameworks supporting animal husbandry.
